selection: Per target, minimum pooled inner-validation absolute grade error; ties use the candidate order. Every inner fit constructs grades and imputes/scales features using its own training subset only.
prediction: Fit six binary events grade > k per target; project each six-probability vector to nonincreasing values by least-squares isotonic regression; recover seven grade probabilities and use their conditional median.
evaluation: One historical outer three-fold partition; all 50 labelled targets reported, primary comparison is 45 aroma/flavour targets. Report both individual fixed candidates and the inner-selected workflow. Do not select a winner from outer scores.
candidate_qualification: Inner-selected workflow must improve primary45 MAE with positive lower endpoint of the paired fixed-OOF 95% bootstrap improvement interval, and must not worsen either grade-0 or grade-6 MAE or exact recall. This is exploratory qualification, not automatic promotion.
promotion: Keep current official outputs/default model. A candidate may be explicitly loaded; formal promotion requires the later authorized task5 repeated validation and task4 downstream checks.
scope: Task2 only. Two ordinal settings frozen before running; no post-result grid expansion. Labels are relative ranks, not original absolute intensity. No two unlabelled acetaldehyde proxies in accuracy denominators.
